payload.lesson: A high-priority component finding without executable verification must emit CANDIDATE_SKIPPED instead of disappearing from selection.
payload.repair: Route component findings through component_verification and attach quality-gate commands from verification.quality-gates.present.

payload.rule: One repair retry per live_diff cycle; planned live calls count initial proposal plus repair attempt.
Proposal plans carry baseLineage, proposal_key, target_paths, and registry_status so duplicates and base-head mismatches are inspectable.
